limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The work2 lab (openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2) is shared with other DOC-030 agents. This walkthrough created only records named DOC-030 portal: one Portal-listed Entity, three contract-scoped catalog Fields, one Contract type with its own Form, one request type that targets it, one type-specific Before you submit link, and the Requests and records named in the log. It changed no seeded record and no organization setting. Development runs before the recorded run left further DOC-030 portal Requests (R-36 to R-48); they are not credited.

Sign-in link requests are budgeted per email address and per client address, and other agents also sign in as Jonas Weber. So one fresh magic link per Business User was read from Mailpit and its browser session was kept outside the repository and reused for the recorded run.

Legal replies, assignment, conversion, resolution, decline, Business Owner change, team-row removal and archive were applied through the API as the Legal Team Member; the staff guides own those controls. Only the Inbox open that sets Read ran in Nadia's browser.

Legal's first attempt to remove Jonas's Matter team row answered 409 "Change the Business Owner before removing this person from the team." Legal cleared the Business Owner first, then the removal worked. The guide's sentence is about what the Requester sees after removal and still holds.
Recovery checks used browser route interception to fail a reply post and a conversation read.
History on a Request listed only comment entries ("<name> commented"); the Legal only note did not appear there.

Product bug confirmed (reported by the author): C-340 has Term type Evergreen, but its Portal Fields card lists the optional Field under the "Term type is Fixed" Branch as Not recorded. The guide only says a Field without a value shows Not recorded, which holds.
The email and notification-preference sentences were not exercised in this walkthrough; the notifications guide owns them.
